overall.summary: SXI's disclosure quality is generally adequate, with extensive quantitative detail on cost/margin dynamics and liquidity risks. The primary concern is the temporal removal of restructuring cost specifics and retirement plan detail from certain MD&A blocks, though these may have been relocated elsewhere in the filing. Several peer comparison flags were either inverted (flagging the peer, not SXI) or reflected genuinely different business circumstances rather than disclosure evasion.
